documents.name: 01-System-Overview.md
documents.content:
# Healthcare Management System

## Overview
A comprehensive hospital management system that digitizes patient records, streamlines appointment scheduling, and integrates billing with insurance claims.

## Stakeholders
- Patients
- Doctors
- Nurses
- Administrators
- Insurance Providers
- Pharmacists
- Lab Technicians

## Key Features
- Patient registration and EHR
- Appointment scheduling
- Doctor consultation workflow
- Pharmacy inventory
- Lab test management
- Billing and insurance claims
- Reporting and analytics

documents.name: 02-Tech-Stack.md
documents.content:
# Tech Stack

- Frontend: React, Material UI
- Backend: Spring Boot, Java 17
- Database: PostgreSQL, MongoDB (EHR documents)
- Message Queue: RabbitMQ
- Storage: AWS S3 (medical images)
- HIPAA Compliance: Encryption at rest, audit logging
